name: Muscle Stimulation
imageAlt: The DEKA Schwarzy body-contouring device on a plain background
summary: Electromagnetic muscle-stimulation technology used for body-toning concerns.
leadAnswer: Muscle Stimulation at Kaiteki uses the Schwarzy (Em-Fit) platform, which delivers electromagnetic energy to induce muscle contractions that are difficult to achieve through voluntary exercise alone. It is considered for body-toning concerns. It acts on muscle, not on fat or body weight, and a doctor confirms that is what you are after before sessions are planned.
seoDescription: Electromagnetic muscle-stimulation treatment in Malaysia for body-toning concerns as part of an individual plan. Book a free consultation at Kaiteki.

figures.caption: A Schwarzy applicator and its strap, positioned before the belt is fastened over the area.

sections.heading: What is Muscle Stimulation?
body: Muscle Stimulation is a non-invasive treatment category that uses electromagnetic energy to induce repeated muscle contractions in a targeted area. At Kaiteki this is delivered using the Schwarzy (Em-Fit) platform.
It is generally considered for muscle tone in areas such as the abdomen, thighs or buttocks, alongside a fitness routine rather than instead of one.

sections.heading: What is a supramaximal contraction?
body: The device delivers electromagnetic energy through an applicator placed over the target muscle group, inducing supramaximal contractions, a level of contraction that is difficult to achieve through voluntary exercise alone.
Repeated contractions work the muscle in a concentrated way. Any change in tone develops gradually over a course of sessions.

sections.heading: Who cannot have electromagnetic muscle stimulation?
body: Metal implants, pacemakers and copper IUDs in or near the treatment field rule it out, which is why the medical history is taken before the belt goes on. It may also not be appropriate during pregnancy or with some medical conditions affecting the treatment area.

sections.heading: What does a Schwarzy session feel like, and what are the side effects?
body: After the area and your goals are assessed, the applicator is strapped over the target muscle group and the device runs a programme of contractions for a set period.
There is no set downtime. Soreness like that after exercise, mild redness or tenderness at the treated area can follow and typically settles within a few days.

sections.heading: Why is muscle stimulation booked as a block?
body: Sessions are usually booked as a short block spaced across a few weeks rather than singly, so the cost is set for the block at consultation. It depends on the area treated, your goals and how you respond.

faqs.q: Is Muscle Stimulation a substitute for exercise?
faqs.a: No. It is a complement to regular exercise and a healthy lifestyle, not a replacement for them.
No. It works on muscle tone, not fat. If fat reduction is the goal, the doctor may discuss fat freezing or microwave contouring instead.
No set downtime. Exercise-like soreness can follow for a few days, more so if you have not trained the area recently.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: A short block spaced across a few weeks is common. As with any muscle work, what it holds depends on what you do between and after the sessions.
